steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: ...Would you be able to walk around a bit with me, Doctor?

options: I'm a little worried about you.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Doctor, did you know? When I was a child, this beach wasn't this busy. I used to like making sand castles by myself.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: ...This city is getting better and better every year, thanks to my father.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: My father and I, well, don't talk a lot.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: I've always wondered... Which is more important, this city and the wealth it brings, or me?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: My mother died when she gave birth to me. Sometimes I think about if that's the reason why he doesn't like me.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: And it feels like he doesn't care if I like him or not. Ever since I can remember, he has rarely been at home because of business. Rather than father and daughter, we're more like two strangers living under the same roof.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Schwarz, I want to go observe the ecosystem of the beach!

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: You mustn't, milady. Master Doykos said you must not go outside without good reason.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: But I'm tired of reading the same old books here! Schwarz, you're no fun at all!

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: My apologies, milady. This is for your safety though; it's dangerous outside.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: But won't you be with me? Are you going to put me in danger?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: ...Of course I wouldn't.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: So, what's the problem then? Let's go!

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: ...In that case, please do not stray from my sight.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: One could say that back then, having Schwarz at my side just felt like a simple fact of life.

steps.name: Male Civilian
steps.text: Hurry up, these ornaments are for tonight's concert.

steps.name: Male Civilian
steps.text: We'll be in trouble if we don't make it on time!

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Oh, that's...

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: If I remember properly, he's the grandson of the owner of the Mockingbird Café on Second Avenue.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: I used to go there a lot. The old storekeeper was a kind man. His wife had already passed away at that time, so he decorated the café with her favorite flowers and bonsai trees, and put on their favorite music.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: But he did say that he was getting too old to run the shop, and would pass the business over to his grandson.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Time sure flies.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Why's that?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Because I have Oripathy, milady.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: It's bad for your health to come too close to me. Please call upon me only when it is necessary.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: What's that? Does it hurt?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: ...It doesn't hurt, but, I will die because of it.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: There is no cure for this disease, milady.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: And...

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: I just have to find the cure then!

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Heh, just you wait! One day, I'll defeat that illness, and snatch you back from its jaws!

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: The reason I became an Originium researcher was because of her. I wanted to cure her.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: That has always been the thing motivating me. I even went to Victoria to pursue this dream.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: However, Originium research is very difficult. At the beginning, I couldn't even grasp the basic concepts and felt like giving up. But I persevered.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Victoria is also very far away, and I couldn't get used to it at first.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: But now, I feel like I'm more of a Victorian than a Siestan.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Doctor, could it be said that everything I have is an illusion?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: I'm willing to pay anything to protect this place.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Hmm... I suppose so. There's no way you'd be able to know.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Then what is it? Something she can't even tell me about?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Besides, no matter what she's struggling with, that much is inevitable because of the sins she has committed.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Doctor, do you think I should give up?

options: I can't answer that for you...
But you are a true Originium researcher.

steps.text: Can we vanquish Oripathy?
Can we save the Infected?
Will there be an end to these tribulations?
If there is, I can't see it. I'm not sure. I don't know how to answer.
Can I just give up? Yes.
But I don't want to.

options: Perhaps the land we've been born into is blighted...
But the things that you've done have not been in vain.
Believe in the choices you've made.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Phew... You're right, Doctor.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Your experience really shows. Looks like I still have a lot to learn.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: First, I need to stop being sentimental and start by finding the proof.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: If they are really putting citizens in danger on purpose, I'll do everything in my power to stop them!

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Because I believe in my own decisions, I'll fight to save this city, even if nobody else will!

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Well said.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Oh, Mister Hellagur!

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: By the looks of things, you've found your answer.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Mhm. Mister Hellagur, Doctor, could you hear me out?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: No matter what, I don't want to see the citizens being put into danger. That's my number one priority. The largest broadcast tower here is located by the Garrison Amusement Park.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: It controls this city's entire broadcast system.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: The broadcast tower?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: However, it's controlled by Cronin's henchmen. He often appears there to speak to the citizens.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: When the major concert begins, everyone's going to be gathered by the stage. Cronin's men are going to be have their hands full trying to keep things orderly.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: As long as we control the tower at that time, we can spread the news throughout the whole city.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: So, I'm asking both of you, please lend me your aid!
